questions.question: What proverb of consequences appears in Hosea 8?
options: They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind
A house built on sand will not stand
Pride goes before the coming fall
As a man sows, so shall he also reap
questions.answer: They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind

questions.question: What had Israel made that God rejected?
options: Idols, including a calf in Samaria
Walls and gates around their cities
A temple to rival the one in Jerusalem
questions.answer: Idols, including a calf in Samaria

questions.question: Hosea 8 says Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces.
They sow the wind, and they shall reap the _____.
I have spurned your _____, O Samaria, says the LORD.
